categories.title: Multimodal Tool Orchestration
categories.description: Systems that plan and execute calls to specialist models, tools, or media workflows. Modality breadth can come from composition rather than one native model.

categories.title: Active Audio-Video Perception and Memory
categories.description: Agents that decide what evidence to inspect or retrieve. Their actions change the information available to the reasoner; they do not necessarily manipulate an external application.

categories.title: GUI and Computer-Use Agents
categories.description: Visual action grounding and closed-loop task execution on websites, desktops, and phones. These are relevant action-side foundations, not claims of full audio-video coverage.

categories.title: Real-Time Interaction and Voice Systems
categories.description: Full-duplex perception and response, interruption handling, and speech-to-tool integration. Interaction components are explicitly separated from tool-capable systems.

categories.title: Agent and Interaction Evaluation
categories.description: Execution environments, tool-use tasks, and selected interaction/perception diagnostics. Evaluation targets and their limits are stated per entry.

categories.title: Supporting Omni Foundation Models
categories.description: A deliberately small set of direct enabling models. Broad modality support or fluent speech alone does not establish autonomous planning or tool execution.

entries.label: Visual ChatGPT
entries.title: Visual ChatGPT: Talking, Drawing and Editing with Visual Foundation Models
entries.summary_en: Connects ChatGPT to visual foundation models through prompts that describe model capabilities, inputs, and outputs. Supports multi-step image understanding, generation, editing, and user corrections; its modality scope is primarily image and text.
entries.summary_zh: 通过描述模型能力、输入和输出的提示，将 ChatGPT 连接到视觉基础模型。支持多步骤图像理解、生成、编辑及用户纠正；其模态范围主要为图像和文本。
entries.evidence_note: Primary-source abstract and submission history; no method-section review claimed.

entries.label: ViperGPT
entries.title: ViperGPT: Visual Inference via Python Execution for Reasoning
entries.summary_en: Generates and executes Python programs that compose vision-language modules through an API for visual reasoning. Provides an executable program-based precursor to multimodal agents; it does not establish a general conversational or full-duplex agent.
entries.summary_zh: 生成并执行 Python 程序，通过 API 组合视觉语言模块开展视觉推理。它是基于可执行程序的多模态智能体前驱工作，并未证明通用对话或全双工智能体能力。
entries.evidence_note: Primary-source abstract and submission history; no method-section review claimed.

entries.label: MM-REACT
entries.title: MM-REACT: Prompting ChatGPT for Multimodal Reasoning and Action
entries.summary_en: Interleaves ChatGPT reasoning with calls to vision experts, returning their observations as text with file references and spatial information. Further calls depend on the accumulated observations; audio is discussed as an extension rather than demonstrated native omni coverage.
entries.summary_zh: 交替进行 ChatGPT 推理与视觉专家调用，将观测转为带文件引用和空间信息的文本。后续调用依据累积观测决定；音频被作为扩展方向讨论，而非已展示的原生全模态覆盖。
entries.evidence_note: Read the action-request parser, expert-output observations, iterative call loop, and extension boundary.

entries.label: HuggingGPT
entries.title: HuggingGPT: Solving AI Tasks with ChatGPT and its Friends in Hugging Face
entries.summary_en: Uses an LLM to decompose requests, select specialist models, execute subtasks with resource dependencies, and summarize results. A foundational example of multimodal capability composition through a language-based controller.
entries.summary_zh: 利用 LLM 分解请求、选择专用模型、按资源依赖执行子任务并总结结果。它展示了通过语言控制器组合多模态能力的奠基性系统思路。
entries.evidence_note: Read the four-stage workflow, task specification, and dependency-aware task planning.

entries.label: AudioGPT
entries.title: AudioGPT: Understanding and Generating Speech, Music, Sound, and Talking Head
entries.summary_en: Combines ChatGPT with specialist audio models and ASR/TTS interfaces for multi-round speech, music, sound, and talking-head tasks. This is model orchestration with spoken interfaces, not evidence of native full-duplex audio-video reasoning.
entries.summary_zh: 将 ChatGPT 与音频专用模型及 ASR/TTS 接口结合，处理多轮语音、音乐、声音和说话人视频任务。这是带语音接口的模型编排系统，并非原生全双工音视频推理的证据。
entries.evidence_note: Primary-source abstract and submission history; no method-section review claimed.

entries.label: Agent-Omni
entries.title: Agent-Omni: Test-Time Multimodal Reasoning via Model Coordination for Understanding Anything
entries.summary_en: A master agent decomposes a request into modality-specific questions, invokes specialist models, and iteratively integrates their answers without retraining. The demonstrated action space is model coordination for understanding, not general GUI or physical control.
entries.summary_zh: 主智能体将请求分解为针对不同模态的问题，调用专用模型，并在不重新训练的情况下迭代整合答案。其展示的行动空间是面向理解的模型协作，而非通用 GUI 或物理控制。
entries.evidence_note: Read the perception, reasoning, execution, decision, and follow-up master-loop descriptions.

entries.label: Qwen3.8-Omni
entries.title: Qwen3.8-Omni: Towards Native Omni-Modal Agents
entries.summary_en: Reports native multimodal co-training and tool-driven audio-video workflows, including on-demand evidence gathering and media production. Qwen-MM-Plugins and Qwen-Live-Harness supply system support for tools and real-time orchestration; this entry concerns the documented agent workflows, not modality support alone.
entries.summary_zh: 报告原生多模态联合训练及工具驱动的音视频工作流，包括按需获取证据和媒体制作。Qwen-MM-Plugins 与 Qwen-Live-Harness 为工具及实时编排提供系统支持；本条目关注已描述的智能体工作流，而不只是模态支持。
entries.evidence_note: Read iterative audiovisual tool calls, sub-agent delegation, meeting follow-up, and media-production workflow descriptions. Harness release statements are abstract-level evidence; no runtime testing.
entries.method_sections: Section 5.1 and the opening of 5.2; abstract for harness releases

entries.label: Omni-IO Skills
entries.title: Omni-IO Skills: Harnessing Your Agent Omni-Native
entries.summary_en: Adds hierarchical skills, a common execution interface, dependency-aware graphs, and a persistent asset registry to existing agents. It composes replaceable multimodal backends and reuses outputs across turns; omni capability belongs to the combined harness and host agent, not a newly trained model.
entries.summary_zh: 为现有智能体增加分层技能、统一执行接口、感知依赖关系的执行图和持久化资产注册表。它组合可替换的多模态后端，并跨轮次复用输出；全模态能力来自支架与宿主智能体的组合，而非新训练的模型。
entries.evidence_note: Read layered host/tool/provider/asset architecture and dependency-aware execution-graph scheduling.

entries.label: VideoAgent (Wang et al.)
entries.title: VideoAgent: Long-form Video Understanding with Large Language Model as Agent
entries.summary_en: Uses an LLM to decide whether to answer or retrieve more video frames, with vision-language captioning and segment-level retrieval as tools. The iterative observation loop targets long-video question answering and does not demonstrate native audio reasoning or external task execution.
entries.summary_zh: 由 LLM 决定作答还是继续检索视频帧，并使用视觉语言描述与片段级检索工具。其迭代观测循环面向长视频问答，未展示原生音频推理或外部任务执行。
entries.evidence_note: Read initial frame captions, answer/search decisions, CLIP retrieval, and caption-based state updates.

entries.label: M3-Agent
entries.title: Seeing, Listening, Remembering, and Reasoning: A Multimodal Agent with Long-Term Memory
entries.summary_en: Builds entity-centric episodic and semantic memory from visual and auditory streams, then reasons through repeated memory-search actions. Uses reinforcement learning and introduces M3-Bench; its control loop is evaluated mainly through memory-grounded video question answering.
entries.summary_zh: 从视觉与听觉流构建以实体为中心的情景记忆和语义记忆，再通过反复搜索记忆进行推理。采用强化学习并引入 M3-Bench；其控制循环主要通过基于记忆的视频问答评估。
entries.evidence_note: Read memory graph, Search/Answer control loop, and separate memorization/control policy initialization. M3-Bench is not duplicated as another inventory row.
entries.method_sections: Sections 4.1, 4.3, and the training setup in 4.4

entries.label: OmniAgent (Tao et al.)
entries.title: Active Perception Agent for Omnimodal Audio-Video Understanding
entries.summary_en: Dynamically chooses visual, audio, and event-localization tools in a coarse-to-fine perception loop. Audio cues help locate relevant events before more detailed inspection; this training-free framework is distinct from the later native OmniAgent by Xing et al.
entries.summary_zh: 在由粗到细的感知循环中动态选择视觉、音频和事件定位工具。音频线索帮助先定位相关事件，再开展更细致的检查；这一无需训练的框架不同于后来 Xing 等人的原生 OmniAgent。
entries.evidence_note: Read modality-specific tools, audio-guided temporal localization, and Think-Act-Observe-Reflect orchestration. The v2 title drops the original OmniAgent prefix.

entries.label: OmniRAG-Agent
entries.title: OmniRAG-Agent: Agentic Omnimodal Reasoning for Low-Resource Long Audio-Video Question Answering
entries.summary_en: Retrieves relevant frames and audio segments from external banks through multi-turn tool calls for budgeted long audio-video question answering. GRPO uses format and answer rewards to improve the policy; retrieval quality and iterative evidence gathering remain part of the system.
entries.summary_zh: 通过多轮工具调用，从外部库检索相关帧和音频片段，在预算约束下完成长音视频问答。GRPO 利用格式与答案奖励改进策略；检索质量和迭代证据获取仍是系统的重要组成部分。
entries.evidence_note: Read image/audio banks, retrieval queries, multi-turn state updates, and gated format/answer rewards in the GRPO objective.

entries.label: OmniAgent (Xing et al.)
entries.title: Native Active Perception as Reasoning for Omni-Modal Understanding
entries.summary_en: Treats audio-video exploration as an Observation-Thought-Action process with on-demand media access and persistent textual memory. Agentic supervised fine-tuning and TAURA reinforcement learning train native active perception; the actions gather evidence rather than control a desktop.
entries.summary_zh: 将音视频探索建模为观测—思考—行动过程，按需访问媒体并保留文本记忆。通过智能体监督微调和 TAURA 强化学习训练原生主动感知；其行动用于获取证据，而非控制桌面。
entries.evidence_note: Read the POMDP formulation, transient media versus persistent memory, trajectory synthesis, and turn-aware reinforcement-learning objective.

entries.label: Light-Omni
entries.title: Light-Omni: Reflex over Reasoning in Agentic Video Understanding with Long-Term Memory
entries.summary_en: Combines a bounded global memory summary with a learned latent state that drives retrieval and response decisions. Targets lower-overhead, memory-based video understanding by reducing iterative explicit reasoning; the reported actions are information access and answering.
entries.summary_zh: 将有界的全局记忆摘要与学习得到的潜在状态结合，由后者驱动检索和响应决策。通过减少显式迭代推理，降低基于记忆的视频理解开销；报告中的行动是信息访问与作答。
entries.evidence_note: Read hierarchical global-state consolidation and latent-state control. No claimed speedup is reproduced in this catalog.

entries.label: SeeAct
entries.title: GPT-4V(ision) is a Generalist Web Agent, if Grounded
entries.summary_en: Separates screenshot-based action generation from grounding the proposed action to a web element. Studies visual and HTML-based grounding, exposing the gap between describing the right action and executing it; manually grounded results are not autonomous-agent results.
entries.summary_zh: 将基于截图的行动生成与将行动定位到网页元素的过程分开。研究视觉和 HTML 辅助定位，揭示描述正确行动与实际执行之间的差距；人工定位结果不等于自主智能体结果。
entries.evidence_note: Read action generation and the element-attribute, textual-choice, and image-annotation grounding alternatives; abstract distinguishes manual oracle grounding.

entries.label: Agent S
entries.title: Agent S: An Open Agentic Framework that Uses Computers Like a Human
entries.summary_en: Combines experience-augmented hierarchical planning with an agent-computer interface for multi-step GUI tasks. Retrieves external knowledge and prior task experience to support planning and execution; this is a visual computer-use system rather than a full omni model.
entries.summary_zh: 将经验增强的分层规划与智能体计算机接口结合，完成多步骤 GUI 任务。检索外部知识及既往任务经验以支持规划和执行；它是基于视觉的计算机操作智能体系统，而非完整的全模态模型。
entries.evidence_note: Read manager knowledge/experience retrieval and the interface rationale for screenshot-based computer control.

entries.label: UI-TARS
entries.title: UI-TARS: Pioneering Automated GUI Interaction with Native Agents
entries.summary_en: Maps screenshots and interaction history to a unified cross-platform action space, with explicit reasoning before actions. Trains on GUI perception, action traces, and reflective online interaction data to improve closed-loop execution.
entries.summary_zh: 将截图和交互历史映射到跨平台统一行动空间，并在行动前进行显式推理。利用 GUI 感知数据、行动轨迹和带反思的在线交互数据训练，以改进闭环执行。
entries.evidence_note: Read screenshot-observation/action loop, unified action space, and online trace bootstrapping.

entries.label: Agent S2
entries.title: Agent S2: A Compositional Generalist-Specialist Framework for Computer Use Agents
entries.summary_en: Routes GUI grounding to specialist models while a hierarchical planner revises the remaining plan after completed subgoals. Separates general reasoning from precise interface localization for desktop and mobile task execution.
entries.summary_zh: 将 GUI 定位交给专用模型，并由分层规划器在子目标完成后修订剩余计划。分离通用推理与精确界面定位，以执行桌面和移动端任务。
entries.evidence_note: Read the worker routing mechanism and proactive hierarchical replanning after subgoal completion.

entries.label: Moshi
entries.title: Moshi: a speech-text foundation model for real-time dialogue
entries.summary_en: Models user and assistant speech in parallel streams, with time-aligned text assisting speech generation. Establishes a full-duplex dialogue architecture for overlap and interruptions; the reviewed contribution does not establish external tool execution.
entries.summary_zh: 以并行流建模用户和助手语音，并用时间对齐的文本辅助语音生成。建立可处理重叠说话与打断的全双工对话架构；所核验贡献并未证明外部工具执行能力。
entries.evidence_note: Read multi-stream speech-to-speech architecture and time-aligned text/audio modeling. The first submission is September 17 despite the 2410 identifier.

entries.label: OmniFlatten
entries.title: OmniFlatten: An End-to-end GPT Model for Seamless Voice Conversation
entries.summary_en: Flattens interleaved speech and text streams into a single sequence and progressively trains modality alignment, half-duplex dialogue, and full-duplex dialogue. Targets natural turn dynamics and low-latency conversation, not a demonstrated tool-using agent.
entries.summary_zh: 将交错的语音和文本流展平为单一序列，逐步训练模态对齐、半双工对话和全双工对话。目标是自然的轮次动态和低延迟交流，并非已展示的工具使用智能体。
entries.evidence_note: Read stream flattening and staged dialogue curriculum; no tool-use loop is asserted.

entries.label: gpt-realtime and Realtime API
entries.title: Introducing gpt-realtime and Realtime API updates for production voice agents
entries.summary_en: Officially documented speech-to-speech system with asynchronous function calling, remote MCP support, and image input. Images are added as conversation items rather than a native live-video stream; applications provide the execution environment.
entries.evidence_note: Read the dated official release, Function calling, Remote MCP server support, and Image input sections. This is a system/API release, not a peer-reviewed paper. No live API call, SDK test, pricing check, or present-day availability validation was performed.
entries.method_sections: Function calling; Remote MCP server support; Image input

entries.label: MiniCPM-o 4.5
entries.title: MiniCPM-o 4.5: Towards Real-Time Full-Duplex Omni-Modal Interaction
entries.summary_en: Aligns visual input, audio input, and text/speech output on a shared timeline through Omni-Flow, enabling continuous perception and proactive response. Time-aligned interleaving addresses speech lag; these interaction capabilities do not by themselves demonstrate tool use.
entries.summary_zh: 通过 Omni-Flow 将视觉输入、音频输入及文本/语音输出对齐到共同时间轴，实现持续感知和主动响应。时间对齐交错机制处理语音滞后；这些交互能力本身并不证明工具使用能力。
entries.evidence_note: Read time-aligned streams, listen tokens, unified serialization, and time-aligned interleaving.

entries.label: GAIA
entries.title: GAIA: a benchmark for General AI Assistants
entries.summary_en: Proposes real-world questions requiring combinations of reasoning, multimodal handling, browsing, and tools. A foundational assistant benchmark whose answer-based evaluation differs from checking a changed computer state; not every question requires all modalities.
entries.summary_zh: 提出需要组合推理、多模态处理、浏览和工具使用的现实问题。它是通用助手评测的奠基性基准，其基于答案的评估不同于检查计算机状态变化；并非每道题都需要所有模态。
entries.evidence_note: Primary-source abstract and submission history; no method-section review claimed.

entries.label: VisualWebArena
entries.title: VisualWebArena: Evaluating Multimodal Agents on Realistic Visual Web Tasks
entries.summary_en: Provides visually grounded tasks in reproducible web environments, requiring agents to interpret images and act on websites. Extends functional evaluation with visual criteria; screenshot or element grounding alone is insufficient to establish task success.
entries.summary_zh: 在可复现的网页环境中提供依赖视觉信息的任务，要求智能体理解图像并操作网站。在功能性评估中加入视觉判据；仅正确理解截图或定位元素不足以证明任务成功。
entries.evidence_note: Read web observations, actions, and functional/visually grounded evaluation. Abstract-page title says Realistic Visual Web Tasks; the v2 HTML heading says Realistic Visually Grounded Web Tasks.

entries.label: OSWorld
entries.title: OSWorld: Benchmarking Multimodal Agents for Open-Ended Tasks in Real Computer Environments
entries.summary_en: Evaluates open-ended tasks in real computer environments using screenshots, optional accessibility information, and mouse/keyboard actions. Task-specific setup and execution-based checks assess application and file outcomes across multi-application workflows.
entries.summary_zh: 利用截图、可选的无障碍信息及鼠标键盘动作，在真实计算机环境中评估开放式任务。通过任务专用初始化与执行结果检查，评估跨应用工作流中的应用及文件结果。
entries.evidence_note: Read execution-based evaluators and observation/action spaces. Historical paper protocol, not the current leaderboard configuration.

entries.label: AndroidWorld
entries.title: AndroidWorld: A Dynamic Benchmarking Environment for Autonomous Agents
entries.summary_en: Runs parameterized tasks on functional Android apps with controlled initialization and state-based rewards. Screenshots and UI trees support perception, while gestures, typing, and limited function APIs support actions; task variation is part of the evaluation.
entries.summary_zh: 在可运行的 Android 应用上执行参数化任务，控制初始化并依据系统状态给出奖励。截图与 UI 树支持感知，手势、输入和有限函数 API 支持行动；任务变化也是评估的一部分。
entries.evidence_note: Read observation/action interface, task initialization and parameterization, and state-based reward construction.

entries.label: VideoWebArena
entries.title: VideoWebArena: Evaluating Long Context Multimodal Agents with Video Understanding Web Tasks
entries.summary_en: Tests whether agents can use video tutorials to retain skills or retrieve facts needed for web tasks. Separates intermediate video-question answers from final environment-state success, exposing the difference between video understanding and acting on it.
entries.summary_zh: 测试智能体能否从视频教程中保留技能，或检索完成网页任务所需的事实。将中间视频问答与最终环境状态成功分开评估，揭示理解视频与据此行动之间的区别。
entries.evidence_note: Read tutorial/task construction, factual-retention categories including audio, and separate intermediate/final evaluators.

entries.label: OmniMMI / M4
entries.title: OmniMMI: A Comprehensive Multi-modal Interaction Benchmark in Streaming Video Contexts
entries.summary_en: Evaluates streaming-video understanding and proactive reasoning, and introduces multiplexed input/output modeling with M4. Includes action-planning and response-timing tasks, but does not constitute a general external-tool execution benchmark.
entries.summary_zh: 评估流式视频理解与主动推理，并通过 M4 引入输入输出复用建模。包含行动规划和响应时机任务，但不构成通用外部工具执行基准。
entries.evidence_note: Read streaming task formulation, task taxonomy, and multiplexing/proactive generation overview.

entries.label: OmniGAIA / OmniAtlas
entries.title: OmniGAIA: Towards Native Omni-Modal AI Agents
entries.summary_en: Constructs cross-modal, multi-hop tasks through event graphs, requiring tool-integrated reasoning over image, audio, and video evidence. Also introduces OmniAtlas, trained with guided trajectory exploration and fine-grained preference correction; its tools include search, browsing, code, and active media access.
entries.summary_zh: 通过事件图构造跨模态多跳任务，要求围绕图像、音频和视频证据开展工具集成推理。同时提出 OmniAtlas，以引导式轨迹探索和细粒度偏好纠正训练；其工具包括搜索、浏览、代码及主动媒体访问。
entries.evidence_note: Read event-graph construction, tool-integrated generation, selective media access, guided tree exploration, and OmniDPO error correction. Benchmark and accompanying agent share one paper row.

entries.label: LVOmniBench
entries.title: LVOmniBench: Pioneering Long Audio-Video Understanding Evaluation for Omnimodal LLMs
entries.summary_en: Tests long audio-video comprehension, including temporal localization, memory, and fine-grained cross-modal evidence. Included as a diagnostic for perception agents; question-answer accuracy alone does not establish tool-use or environment-control ability.
entries.summary_zh: 测试长音视频理解，包括时间定位、记忆和细粒度跨模态证据处理。作为感知智能体的诊断基准收录；问答准确率本身不能证明工具使用或环境控制能力。
entries.evidence_note: Primary-source abstract and submission history; no method-section review claimed.

entries.label: Full-Duplex-Bench-v3
entries.title: Full-Duplex-Bench-v3: Benchmarking Tool Use for Full-Duplex Voice Agents Under Real-World Disfluency
entries.summary_en: Pairs natural human speech disfluencies with chained tool-use scenarios, evaluating tool selection, arguments, completion, latency, and turn taking. Uses deterministic local mock APIs, so measured latency excludes real network/service delays and does not certify production performance.
entries.summary_zh: 将自然人类语音中的不流畅现象与链式工具使用情景配对，评估工具选择、参数、完成情况、延迟及轮次控制。使用确定性的本地模拟 API，因此测得延迟不含真实网络/服务延迟，也不能认证生产性能。
entries.evidence_note: Read deterministic zero-latency mock APIs, human audio collection, and tool/argument/task/timing metrics. Source describes the paper as work in progress.

entries.label: Omni-DuplexEval
entries.title: Omni-DuplexEval: Evaluating Real-time Duplex Omni-modal Interaction
entries.summary_en: Evaluates continuous real-time descriptions and proactive reminders with timestamp-aware assessment of content and response timing. Uses an LLM judge for interaction quality; it measures duplex behavior rather than general-purpose tool execution.
entries.summary_zh: 通过感知时间戳的评估，检查连续实时描述和主动提醒中的内容与响应时机。使用 LLM 评判交互质量；衡量的是双工行为，而非通用工具执行。
entries.evidence_note: Read task taxonomy and distinct content/timing evaluation pipelines.

entries.label: OmniAssistBench
entries.title: OmniAssistBench: Assistant-style Interaction Benchmark for Omni-LLMs
entries.summary_en: Builds goal-oriented, multi-turn assistant tasks from segmented videos, including visual references, context retention, and event-dependent responses. Evaluation simulates online interaction offline along predefined routes; it does not test freely branching user-agent interaction.
entries.summary_zh: 从分段视频构建面向目标的多轮助手任务，涵盖视觉指代、上下文保持及事件触发响应。评估沿预设路径离线模拟在线交互，并不测试可自由分支的用户—智能体交互。
entries.evidence_note: Read offline simulation format, task design, and teacher-forcing diagnostic; abstract explains fixed route priors.

entries.label: GPT-4o System Card
entries.title: GPT-4o System Card
entries.summary_en: Documents an end-to-end omni model and its capability, limitation, and safety evaluations, especially speech-to-speech interaction. Included as a foundation for multimodal assistants; the system card alone is not evidence of an autonomous action loop or of every described modality being publicly exposed.
entries.summary_zh: 记录端到端全模态模型的能力、局限和安全评估，尤其关注语音到语音交互。作为多模态助手的基础收录；系统卡本身不能证明自主行动循环，也不能证明所有描述的模态均已公开开放。
entries.evidence_note: Primary-source abstract and submission history; no method-section review claimed.

entries.label: Qwen2.5-Omni
entries.title: Qwen2.5-Omni Technical Report
entries.summary_en: Uses Thinker-Talker modeling, time-aligned multimodal position encoding, and streaming speech generation to connect text, images, audio, and video. Directly supports later perception agents such as M3-Agent; the base report is not evidence of a general tool-use loop.
entries.summary_zh: 通过 Thinker-Talker 建模、时间对齐多模态位置编码及流式语音生成，连接文本、图像、音频和视频。直接支撑 M3-Agent 等后续感知智能体；基础模型报告并非通用工具使用循环的证据。
entries.evidence_note: Read architecture and streaming design. M3-Agent explicitly initializes its memorization policy from Qwen2.5-Omni.
entries.method_sections: Sections 2.1-2.2 and 2.4; M3-Agent Section 4.4 for downstream link

entries.label: Qwen3-Omni
entries.title: Qwen3-Omni Technical Report
entries.summary_en: Extends Thinker-Talker with mixture-of-experts components, multi-codebook speech generation, and a causal waveform decoder. Decoupled text and speech pathways allow external tool-related intervention, but the architecture alone does not establish an autonomous agent.
entries.summary_zh: 以混合专家组件、多码本语音生成和因果波形解码器扩展 Thinker-Talker。解耦的文本与语音路径允许外部工具相关干预，但架构本身并不能证明自主智能体能力。
entries.evidence_note: Read decoupled Thinker/Talker interface, function-calling intervention example, and multi-codebook speech generation.
